note: Static reference matrix for future server-side implementation. Every action additionally requires store membership, tenant isolation, field restrictions, expectedVersion and transition guards. Not proof of authorization tests.

rowGuards.all: authenticated actor with active store membership; tenant and store derived server-side, never from untrusted payload; enforce least privilege
rowGuards.COURIER: only assigned delivery orders; cannot read full queue or view unrelated customer addresses
rowGuards.KITCHEN: operational order-items-only projection; no full delivery address, customer phone, payment tokens, fraud notes or private analytics
rowGuards.CASHIER: payment + totals projection; personal data minimized to receipt requirements, not full order history by default
rowGuards.VIEWER: read-only non-sensitive redacted projections, no raw customer contact or full address
rowGuards.COUNTER: order operational view; delivery address only when necessary for dispatch and only if store policy permits
rowGuards.OWNER/MANAGER: financial/customer view limited to legitimate operational purpose, subject to logging and retention
rowGuards.on_duplicate_membership: a user with roles in more than one store must explicitly select active store; a query must always filter by chosen authorized store

actionGuards.order.accept: orderState=PLACED, expectedVersion, correct store; optional capacity check
actionGuards.order.reject: orderState=PLACED, reason mandatory, compensating payment flow for charged orders
actionGuards.order.start_preparation: orderState=ACCEPTED, cannot start an unpaid online order before authorized payment state
actionGuards.order.mark_ready: orderState=PREPARING, no implicit dispatch or delivery
actionGuards.order.dispatch: orderState=READY and fulfillment=DELIVERY, courier handoff verified as configured
actionGuards.order.complete_pickup: orderState=READY and fulfillment=PICKUP, evidence of pickup
actionGuards.order.complete_delivery: orderState=DISPATCHED and fulfillment=DELIVERY, assigned COURIER or authorized manager, proof as configured
actionGuards.order.cancel: orderState in allowed cancellable set, recorded reason, manager approval, compensation/reconciliation if required
actionGuards.payment.record_offline: method=CASH_ON_DELIVERY or CARD_ON_DELIVERY and collection verified; buyer cannot mark PAID; dedicated endpoint, unique receipt event, audit and anti-duplicate
actionGuards.payment.refund_request: manager/owner only, valid refundable payment, evidence/amount, idempotency
actionGuards.payment.refund_approve: manager/owner only, separation of duties for material amounts when policy enabled, provider settlement verified
actionGuards.operation.pause: no automatic cancellation; blocks only new orders after state change, authorized actor; records reason
actionGuards.kds.acknowledge: does not mutate order payment or silently accept an order; acknowledgment is independent delivery/read receipt
actionGuards.kds.reprint: re-print does not duplicate tickets or orders; immutable reprint audit event
actionGuards.order.assign_courier: DELIVERY only, authorized dispatcher, valid courier assigned within same tenant/store
